entities.summary: Lucien Lux is a politician and trade unionist from Luxembourg. He was a member of the Chamber of Deputies representing the Luxembourg Socialist Workers' Party from 1989 to 2013. He served as a minister in the first government of prime minister Jean-Claude Juncker, from 2004 until 2009. He later retired from the chamber and was appointed to the Council of State. Lucien Lux was a labor organizers from Troisvierges (b. 1956-09-13, Troisvierges). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history.
